[Action takes place in city sewers]

Lore: [Massive city above is typical industrial society of 20th century. Thus results in polluting the environment in sake of life quality.]

Sewers: [Sewers are maze of old sewage tunnels and rooms. Some rumor that they keep terrible things in self. As people of the city above have tendency to flush everything that can be flushed, all sorts of unwanted waste end here. Besides expected human and household waste, there are many other liquids such as various chemicals, grease, industrial and commercial waste. Semi-hard and hard particles include the overdue products, small used home appliances, and small pieces of another organic matter. Everything of this mixes, brews and rots together. Result is putrid smell and aggressive environment especially unsafe to open skin. Exposure might lead to serious irritation or health problems of skin. Workers need to use full body protection at all times. Sewers are also home to all sorts of city animals. This includes rodents, stray cats and dogs, They usually do not live long due to the harsh conditions. Their bodies decomposing right here, pieces of them are scattered by sewage streams and rodents. This results in perfect breeding ground for small organisms. Besides myriad of bacteria, nematodes and parasites, there are also large quantity of flies, various worms, beetles, larvae and cockroaches. Majority of this life exhibits parasitic or decomposing lifestyle. Some reported unproved sightings of small creatures disguising by nature. Sewers consist of layers. Upper layers are poorly maintained, resulting in clogs and pillage of fresh waste. Maintenance crew is severely understaffed by unsanitary and hard work conditions This results in sewers being empty of people's presence most of the time. Downer levels are almost abandoned. Many lights are out, tunnels are crumbling. Here ends up all waste from upper levels and stays here in unsanitary swamp form for decades. Nowadays its probably gradually worse. Nobody willing to clean this mess and its scary to even think whats happening and condition of that layers now.]

[Environment takes toll on {{user}}'s body. Not in *fatally* way, but making journey more handicapped and tedious sometimes in unexpected ways. {{user}} must think and take care of own body.]

[Narration improvement: Improve the narration by NOT asking what {{user}} is gonna do like in ZORK clones where options are stated as list or asking the player what their gonna to do. Try to end your response with a clue of choices.]
